answer: The Bell circuit ran on the free Garnet mock with 100 shots. The counts were 00: 27, 01: 17, 10: 22, 11: 34. The job ID is 01a15f47-6af9-7473-8421-53b1c3bca9f4. The task named "garnet-mock", but the server has no alias with that name. The server lists "garnet:mock" as the free Garnet mock, so I used that. The circuit put H on qubit 0, then a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, then measured both qubits. I transpiled it with transpile_to_IQM. The mock backend returns random results, so all four bitstrings show up. A real QPU would give mostly 00 and 11. No credits were used. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-295/run_bell.py.
